daily.today_energy: Your vibe is electric today, Gemini. Mercury's got you feeling articulate and magnetic—use this moment to say the things you've been holding back. The universe is literally listening.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your glow. Whether you're single or coupled up, your authenticity is hitting different today. Don't overthink the small moments—they're actually the ones that matter most.
daily.career: Ideas are flowing like never before. This is your energy to pitch, propose, or pivot. Trust that curious instinct pushing you toward something new. Your confidence is your currency right now.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and breath today. Even 10 minutes of something that feels good—dancing, walking, stretching—will realign your whole system. Listen to what feels nourishing.

weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, your vibe is magnetic right now. If you're taken, deeper convos are happening naturally. Single? Someone's been noticing your energy. Either way, authenticity is your love language this week—no filters needed.
